articles.title: Best Social Media Updates With Latest Features News in
articles.content: Jennet Robinson12 minutes read October 29, 2025 Now that we are halfway through 2025, its time to reflect on all the notable updates that social media has rolled out so far. From AI integrations to brand personalization, social media is making changes at lightning speed for a better user experience. But heres the real question: are you, as a marketer, keeping up with these trends? Missing out on these social media updates means missing out on engagement, reach, and overall growth. To make sure that you do not miss them, we have curated this blog on major social media news in 2025. The importance of social media in todays world cannot be overstated. It is important for every brand to know the latest social media updates around it to maximize the benefits it reaps from them. Check out these latest social media news  trends in 2025, below: Social media platforms have already started with the AI-generated content, but in 2025, the feature will become a pro. Users can now easily rely on the AI-generated content, such as captions, targeting, marketing copies, and more. Around 71 of social media marketers incorporate AI tools into their strategies. So, AI content is now becoming smarter and mainstream, analyzing the trends and shaping diverse industries. Social Medias biggest flex this year? Communities are building around Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads, and Reddit, and are giving massive levels of social media engagement. Niche is the new hero in the game, gathering like-minded individuals who give them huge support. Small UGC creators are supporting each other, and even brands are targeting these big and small creators for their reach. This social media update has helped many brands improve their algorithm, making followers feel valued. Social media platforms are pushing user-generated content and native platform videos more than ever before. Gone are the days when branded content and polished videos used to rank. The latest social media updates favour authenticity, creativity, and unpolished content to drive credibility and trust. When was the last time you Googled a restaurant recommendation? Chances are, youre headed straight to Instagram or TikTok for the recommendation or review. Thats the power of social media search; it has completely changed how SEO used to work. Social media is changing our search habits. Around 40 of GenZs use TikTok or Instagram to search for a place to have lunch rather than using Google. Hence, it is clear that social media news in 2025, multi-channel optimization is essential rather than only focusing on search engines. Social commerce has emerged as a transformative industry in the retail sector, changing the way brands used to connect with customers. Around one-third of all the shoppers found a new product or brand on social media. Nowadays, there are more in-app purchases, live shopping, UGC based shopping, all via social media websites such as TikTok, Insta, Facebook, and more. This is because it has now become more convenient for users to buy directly from these channels rather than searching on Google, making the shopping journey frictionless. Heres the list of social media updates for each platform in 2025: Instagram is constantly bringing up updates and changes in its algorithm. Have a look at the social media news of Instagram in 2025: a). Repost on Instagram: Now, users on Instagram can repost reels and engaging social media posts, making it easier for them to share their interests with their followers. A new tab will be created on your profile where all your reposted social media content will be displayed. For example, if you are a creator, then any user can repost your content on their profile, but the original credit will be yours. b). See Friends on Map: This social media update of Instagram allows you to share your location with your close friends or a custom list of friends. Once shared, they will be able to see your location on their Instagram friends map. c). New Friends Reel Tab: Now, there is a new tab in the reels tab, as Friends, that allows you to see the content your friends have interacted with. This social media update of Instagram helps users see the content your followers are engaging with, and makes it easier for creators to frame strategies. d). Launch of Reels Reply with Avatars: Users can now reply in the reels using their avatars and add them to their reels as well. This makes it even more interactive than users using the reels comments section to mention their friends on social media. e). More visibility for broadcast channels: Instagrams broadcast channels have gained momentum in recent times. Now, creators can easily create them and share them in their profiles and interact with their followers on broadcast, leading to enhanced social media community creation and engagement.
